## The data

The following is data from @tucker2019.
Loading the `.Rda` file attaches the data as `dat`.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
#| label: dat

load("data/tucker2019/MALD1_1_AllData.Rda")

dat <- as_tibble(dat)
dat
```

We do some data transformation for later.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
#| label: dat-transform

dat <- dat |> 
  mutate(
    RT_log = log(RT), PhonLev_log = log(PhonLev),
    IsWord = factor(IsWord, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))
  )

dat_f <- dat |> 
  filter(RT > 0)

set.seed(3181)
dat_sample <- dat_f |> 
  filter(Subject %in% sample(unique(dat_f$Subject), 30)) |> 
  slice_sample(n = 150, by = Subject)
```
:::

## Modelling


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
#| label: centre

dat_sample <- dat_sample |> 
  mutate(
    PhonLev_logc = PhonLev_log - mean(PhonLev_log)
  )
```
:::




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
#| label: rt-bm

rt_bm <- brm(
  RT ~ IsWord * PhonLev_logc + (IsWord * PhonLev_logc | Subject),
  family = lognormal,
  data = dat_sample,
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(2),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  seed = 2743,
  file = "data/cache/rt_bm"
)

fixef(rt_bm)
```

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
#| label: rt-epred

grid <- expand_grid(
  IsWord = factor(c("TRUE", "FALSE"), levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE")),
  PhonLev_logc = seq(min(dat_sample$PhonLev_logc), max(dat_sample$PhonLev_logc), by = 0.01)
)

rt_epred <- epred_draws(
  rt_bm,
  grid,
  re_formula = NA
) |> 
  mutate(
    PhonLev_log = PhonLev_logc + mean(dat_sample$PhonLev_log),
    PhonLev = exp(PhonLev_log)
  )
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
#| label: epred-pl

rt_epred |> 
  group_by(.row, PhonLev, IsWord) |> 
  summarise(
    mean = mean(.epred),
    lo = quantile2(.epred, probs = 0.025), hi = quantile2(.epred, probs = 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(PhonLev, mean)) +
  geom_line(aes(colour = IsWord)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = IsWord), alpha = 0.5)
```
